title: He is not here

verses.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.

caption:
The tomb was empty, and that still changes how the ordinary mornings feel.

The angel did not say wait and see. He said come and look at the place where He lay. The same risen Jesus meets you in whatever today holds.

Matthew 28:6 (BSB)

Save this for a morning when hope feels thin.
